purpose: Teach: 実写/か国/捧げる/煽り/引っ張ら/鵜呑み/広める/築か

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漫画の実写化、研究テーマですね。
lines.en: Ren, manga-to-live-action adaptations — that's your research focus, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Settles into the question like she's already interested in where this goes. Clear, unhurried pacing. Supportive eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。世界の四十か国で公開された事例、調査しました。
lines.en: Yes. I looked into case studies from about forty countries where these films were released.
lines.style: Careful, methodical delivery. Slight pause before numbers to show the research weight. Modest but not self-deprecating. Even rhythm, like laying out facts he stands behind.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 監督が、作品に人生を捧げる例、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: The directors who completely dedicate themselves to bringing the work to life — that was really striking.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Light emphasis on 'completely' — acknowledging the depth she noticed. Warm reflection, not lecturing. Inviting him to agree.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。SNSの煽り、興行に影響していました。
lines.en: Yes. Social media hype actually had a significant impact on the box office numbers.
lines.style: Analytical but not clinical. Slight wonder in the voice — a connection he'd traced. Deliberate pacing, letting each thought settle. Not rushing to the next point.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 業界全体に引っ張られない視点、論文の強みですね。
lines.en: That independence from industry pressure — that's actually one of the strongest parts of your paper.
lines.style: Genuine recognition. Steady, confident delivery. Not flattery — earned assessment. Slight lean forward in the voice. Recognition of thought, not just effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。批評を鵜呑みにせず、自分で観るよう、推奨しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm recommending that people don't just accept what critics say — that they watch these films for themselves.
lines.style: Conviction tempered with humility. Slight emphasis on 'watch for themselves' — the core idea. Earnest without being preachy. Measured pace, like he's thought this through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い作品を広める意義、結論に書きましたね。
lines.en: You actually made a really nice point in your conclusion about the value of promoting genuinely good work.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Conversational, like she's reflecting back something he clearly believes in. Natural pacing, no performance. Noticing his point, not just his effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新たなジャンルとして築かれる可能性、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I argued that this could develop into an entirely new genre in its own right.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Slight expansion on 'new genre' — ownership of the idea without overstatement. Thoughtful close, like the conclusion matters to him. Steady, grounded.
